violation_type.title: Medication Authorization Expires on First Anniversary (26 TAC §747.3603(b))
violation_type.short_title: Medication Authorization Expires on First Anniversary
violation_type.typical_finding: The signed medication authorization expired in 2023 and there was not an updated medication authorization on file for a child still receiving administered medication.
